name: Rebel Camp
summary: At Rebel Camp, Alliance soldiers hold a fortified refuge in northern Stranglethorn Vale. Lieutenant Doren leads those who broke from Colonel Kurzen and now fight to survive and end his tyranny.

sections.title: A Stand Against Madness
sections.body:
Colonel Kurzen's expedition pushed deep into Stranglethorn Vale on Stormwind's behalf. But the jungle turned against it. Dark magic and the curse of the ogre mage Mai'Zoth drove Kurzen and his closest loyalists mad. They went rogue and terrorized the wilds.

Lieutenant Doren led the handful who kept their minds. They refused to join the atrocities and broke from Kurzen's Compound before building a hidden camp in the north. From there, they wage a desperate guerrilla campaign against their former comrades.

sections.title: Holding the Line
sections.body:
Near the Duskwood border, the Rebel Camp perches precariously under constant threat. Stormwind sends no regular relief, so Doren relies on covert supplies and defensive arms to hold the perimeter against Kurzen's raiding parties. Goblin explosives brokered through Booty Bay help fortify the camp.

For Alliance travelers heading south into the savage jungle, the camp is a vital first foothold of sanity.

faq.q: Who are the rebels at the Rebel Camp?
faq.answer: The rebels are former Stormwind soldiers from Colonel Kurzen's expedition into Stranglethorn Vale. When Kurzen and his inner circle fell to madness and tyranny, Lieutenant Doren led them in mutiny so they could escape and oppose their former commander.

faq.q: Why is it called the Rebel Camp if they are loyal to Stormwind?
faq.answer: They rebelled against Colonel Kurzen's command, not Stormwind. Since Kurzen commanded them, defying his orders counted as mutiny, though they remain loyal to the Alliance and Stormwind.

faq.q: How does the camp survive without official Stormwind support?
faq.answer: Lieutenant Doren keeps the camp supplied through covert connections beyond official supply lines. Krazek in Booty Bay provides land mines and vital gear to strengthen its defenses.
Kurzen and his deranged followers occupy Kurzen's Compound, a fortified base directly southeast of the Rebel Camp.

angles.text: The Rebel Camp is your main staging ground and safest haven as you cross south from Duskwood over the bridge into Stranglethorn Vale.
As a human, seeing fellow Stormwind regulars unravel in the jungle is sobering. Lieutenant Doren needs fellow subjects of the kingdom to help end Kurzen's disgraced outfit.
